items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: Yeah, what's up, Joe? You know, he could play a lot like he loved rags like that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I think it's been a good job.

It's mixed gray. It was almost white and it was a tuxedo. It looks so good. It was more sharp and everything. I didn't get to say, oh, tuxedo. It was a rag time, man. It was just a beautiful time. Yeah, what's up, Joe? You know, he could play a lot like he loved rags like that. Oh, see, I don't know that he had rags. I had half four years, and I had four years. What was the first time here?
